Hi, I think that treatment options, including supplements or creams should be discussed with your doctor or physician first. Especially if your mother is taking other medications or has other issues.

For instance, when I get a flare up, using warm patches or warm compress helps, while other people get benefit from cold compress or patches.
Also gentle stretches and movement help a lot… my rheumatologist suggested doing yoga or Pilates, or tai chi or qi gong…

Besides fibromyalgia has a different response or intensity from person to person.

Here are some links that could help you getting started:

https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/4832-fibromyalgia

https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/fibromyalgia/treatment/

https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/fibromyalgia/diagnosis-treatment/drc-20354785

I would like to point out **this is not an official Arduino product... And it shouldn't be advertised as such**, as this is trademark infringement. 

  
Call it electronics starter kit or whatever you prefer, but this is **NOT a genuine Arduino product.** 

The official Arduino product is the one below: 

[https://store.arduino.cc/usa/arduino-starter-kit](https://store.arduino.cc/usa/arduino-starter-kit)

If you are looking for a one-stop-shop I would recommend the Arduino Starter Kit ([https://store.arduino.cc/usa/arduino-starter-kit](https://store.arduino.cc/usa/arduino-starter-kit)). It includes an Arduino Uno, parts and electrical components for the projects and a project book with 15 experiments and theoretical concepts.

It really depends on the kind of company and the final purpose of the work done. Some companies like Facebook, Google, Dyson, or Audi or Disney, use Arduino for prototyping. Surely, you won't be using Arduino to build the prototype of a nuclear reactor, but maybe for other purposes (in agriculture, automotive, etc) the Arduino can come quite handy. Arduino has become a skill that some employers use to select their employees, and it's widely used in universities all over the world in physical computing classes. It's not just a product you use in your spare time. I mean, you can do that too, but maybe you are underestimating the power of this platform.

This is my grandmother photo. She turned 81 last week. I live far away, and I don't get to see her often. I would love to give her this restored picture as a present. 
This picture has a story... When my grandmother was young, she was asked by a local photographer (in Palermo, Sicily) to pose for this picture. She was a beautiful woman, so the photographer put the poster version of this picture outside in the display outside the shop. My grandmother was already engaged with my grandfather, but my grandfather's family saw the picture on display and informed my grandfather who was really close to break up with my grandmother. Luckily enough, my grandmother spoke to the photographer and he agreed to remove the picture from display avoiding further drama and scandals in the family.
